entries.name: Department of Agriculture - Veterinary Services after-hours emergency line (Grand Cayman)
entries.address: 181 Lottery Road, Lower Valley, Bodden Town
entries.duty: After-hours emergency veterinary line (listed as livestock emergency). Office Mon-Fri 8:30-17:00 on +1 345 947 3090.
entries.note: doa.gov.ky contact page labels 345-916-2218 'Livestock Emergency'; doa.gov.ky/faqs/ lists the same number as the after-hours emergency veterinary service number. No explicit '24 h' wording, so emergency_24h=false.

entries.name: Department of Agriculture - Cayman Brac emergency vet (Animal Health Assistant)
entries.address: Spot Bay Road, Spot Bay, Cayman Brac
entries.duty: Emergency vet contact on Cayman Brac (after hours). Office Mon-Fri 8:30-16:30 on +1 345 948 0522 / 948 1411.
entries.note: Contact page: 'Emergency Vet 345-925-5765'; FAQ marks it after-hours emergency. Aug 2025 notice said that during the assistant's absence emergencies went to 345-916-2218 (radiocayman.gov.ky/community-events/cayman-brac-animal-health-assistant-unavailable). Island has no permanent private vet per Cayman Compass 2020.

entries.name: Cayman Animal Hospital
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:00-17:00, last Saturday of the month 8:00-13:00, closed Sunday. Emergency line +1 345 916 7387 (clients only): after hours on weekdays and 24/7 on weekends and public holidays.
entries.note: Confirmed on the clinic's own site (name, address, phone, hours). 24-h claim: meta description says 'Get 24/7 emergency service'; services page says the emergency line runs after hours on weekdays and 24/7 weekends/holidays, clients only (non-clients pay a surcharge). Kept emergency_24h=true on that basis.

entries.name: Kman Vets
entries.address: Units 1 & 2, Midtown Plaza, 273 Elgin Avenue, George Town
entries.duty: Mon-Fri 8:00-18:00, Sat 8:30-13:30, appointments only, closed Sunday and public holidays. After-hours emergency line +1 345 525 5838. Mobile visits Tue and Sat mornings.
entries.note: Confirmed on own site. Site lists 'Emergency Care' 24/7 but describes the after-hours line as advice and assistance; it does not say whether in-person treatment is available at night - phone first. Emergency number 525-5838 (Radio Cayman 2020) confirmed current.

entries.name: Island Veterinary Services (IVS)
entries.duty: Mon-Wed and Fri 8:00-18:00, Thu 8:00-17:00, Sat 8:00-13:00, closed Sunday. Emergency line +1 345 916 2459.
entries.note: Confirmed on own site (address, phone, hours, emergency number); no 24 h wording.

entries.name: Seven Mile Animal Centre (36 345 Vets)
entries.note: Name and phone 326-3450 confirmed on a second (non-Cayman Resident) page; street address 'Lawrence Bl 36' and hours Mon-Fri 8-17 appear only on the caymanresident.com profile, so were removed. Own site (345vets.com) not found/opened.

entries.name: The Veterinary Clinic and Specialty Pet Boarding
entries.duty: Clinic with specialty pet boarding. Call for hours and emergencies.
entries.note: Phone 945-1242 (BringFido) and location Countryside Shopping Village, Savannah (Cayman Compass 2011, old) confirmed; street '33 Hirst Road' and emergency line 926 1242 only on caymanresident.com profile, so removed. Compass 2011 says emergency services offered, no number.

entries.name: The Mobile Vet Company
entries.address: House-call service, Grand Cayman (PO Box 31623, George Town)
entries.note: Confirmed on own site (phone, hours) and visitcaymanislands.com. No emergency or 24 h wording.

notes: Independent check 2026-11-16: all 8 entries opened. DoA lines confirmed on doa.gov.ky (no explicit 24 h wording, so false). Own sites opened for Cayman Animal Hospital, Kman Vets, IVS and Mobile Vet Company. Seven Mile Animal Centre and The Veterinary Clinic only have name+phone confirmed outside caymanresident.com; unverified address/hours/emergency line were removed. Cayman Brac and Little Cayman have no private clinics (Brac DoA Animal Health Assistant only). No CIVMA or government clinic register found. Not covered: other Grand Cayman clinics (West Bay, Bodden Town, East End, North Side), Camana Bay clinics, Petopia/Cayman Pet Paradise (boarding, not vets).
